note: Re-judged 2026-11-11 by an independent auditor (not the author) after fsm.go::handleEAPResponse and responder_eap.go::handleResponderEAP changed in 9019fe4d21 and a49d4d301f. RFC 3748 Section 4: "Since EAP only defines Codes 1-4, EAP packets with other codes MUST be silently discarded by both authenticators and peers." Both handlers now open the SK payload through openProtected (protected_input.go), which drops input that fails its integrity check before any EAP processing (nothing written to the SA, nothing sent) and returns only authenticated-malformed errors wrapping errInnerParse; a chain failure is wrapped as "%w: %w" with errInnerChain, so eapMessageDiscarded (errors.Is ErrEAPLengthExceedsData) still matches and is still asked first, before the StateDead arm. wire.PayloadEAP parsing accepts any Code, so an authenticated packet with Code 0, 5 or 255 opens cleanly and reaches ps.Process (peer, result.Discarded return with no state, Message ID or retransmit change) or sess.Process (authenticator, nil next, no send) exactly as before; the new drop arm only widens silence for unauthenticated input and cannot turn a discard into a state change. responder.go::handleResponderInbound, core eap.go::Process and peer.go::Process are unchanged since the 2026-11-10 judgement, and the three tagged units are byte-identical. TestEngineDiscardedEAPCodesPreserveExchange seals its injected Codes with the production builder buildEncryptedMessageEx under the live SA keys, the same path that seals the held-back valid packets, so the injected packets pass openProtected and exercise the RFC 3748 arm rather than the unauthenticated drop: a sealing defect would also redden the valid controls. It asserts both roles keep state, expected/next Message ID, LastSentMsg, retransmit time and count, and send nothing on UDP, then the held-back valid packet advances each round and the exchange ends with matching nonzero MSKs and a verified AUTH. The core units assert the authenticator answers nothing for Codes 0, 5, 255 and the peer reports Discarded with no response, error, Done or MSK, state and round budget unchanged, before legitimate packets complete. Residual note: the engine test calls decryptAndParse, now a test-only helper in protected_input_test.go; the spec's next phase deleting it must keep that helper or rewrite the call. Verdict stands. Tests not re-run by this judge.
